scope.interactionChannel: real macOS secondary click and pointer selection via cliclick after exact-PID AX frontmost activation

observations.name: physical Copy branch name selection
observations.detail: After priming the system clipboard with t3-fidelity-sentinel, cliclick secondary-clicked the visible main control and selected the exact AXMenuItem center. Signal-based polling observed the clipboard change to main on the third 250 ms check.

classification.closedProductLoss: The system-native branch menu is physically reachable and Copy branch name writes the canonical branch to the macOS clipboard.
missingCoverage: Dark-theme menu appearance was not repeated.
classification.harnessLoss: Direct CGEvent mouseDown/mouseUp injection did not produce a reliable native-menu selection and caused the prior baseline to misclassify the leaf action. The accepted cliclick channel plus clipboard polling does.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: Native uses an operating-system menu rather than a renderer-drawn overlay.
